evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Here, we introduce AssayBench-Loop, a large-scale benchmark for adaptive hit discovery comprising 1,389 CRISPR screens across five phenotype categories.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Many biological discovery problems require experiments to be selected sequentially under constrained budgets.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On temporally held-out screens, AssayLoop achieves a 5.67-fold enrichment over random selection and recovers 27.7% of hits after assaying approximately 5% of the candidate library, outperforming existing adaptive-design methods and standalone LLMs, and AssayFormer alone.
